name: How do I choose the right contractor for my attached ADU project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my attached ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for an attached ADU involves several key steps. Look for contractors with specific experience in ADU construction and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Verify their licensing, insurance, and bond status. Request references from previous clients and contact them to inquire about their experience with the contractor's professionalism, communication, and adherence to timelines and budgets. Obtain detailed bids from multiple contractors and compare them thoroughly, ensuring they cover the full scope of work, including design, permits, and construction. A good contractor will also be familiar with local ADU regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with ADU experience, verified licenses and insurance, good references, and comprehensive bids that include all project phases.
